newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Petrobras March oil output down.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Petrobras March oil output down.

text.p: Consumption in Brazil of petroleum products averaged 1,541,500 barrels of oil per day (bpd) in March, down 1.4 percent on February's daily average, state oil monopoly Petrobras said in a statement.
But the figure represents a 3.8 percent increase on March last year, Petrobras said.
Daily natural gas output stood at 15.5 million cubic meters in March, down from 17.2 million cubic meters in February.
Of the total, diesel accounted for 539,500 bpd and gasoline for 292,500 bpd, Petrobras said.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
